in_marathi.name: Ragvitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rag: Melody, Vitha: Woman
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ragvitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rag: Melody, Vitha: Woman. Ragvitha is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Rag' meaning melody, and 'Vitha' meaning woman. The name Ragvitha is a beautiful combination of music and femininity.
